web.scope: Released 18.03.2026: comments since 15.05.2026 plus the launch discussions. Hacker News comments (none found), Hugging Face discussions, llama.cpp and Ollama issues. Reddit not found. **Feedback thin.**
web.summary: Second most faithful of five models in one side-by-side test on a hard scan; weak in Arabic and Hindi according to users; nothing on French or German.
web.verdict: Faithful on hard scans in one test; clean Apache 2.0; FR/DE untested

comments.text: Same hard low-resolution scan of a legal form through five models: faithfulness order olmOCR-2, Qianfan-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL, HunyuanOCR, Unlimited-OCR; olmOCR-2 and Qianfan-OCR stayed faithful ([rhirae, HF #3 of Unlimited-OCR, 25.06.2026](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Unlimited-OCR/discussions/3)).

Poor accuracy reported in Arabic ([HF #12, 13.04.2026](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Qianfan-OCR/discussions/12)) and in mixed Hindi and English text ([HF #7, 20.03.2026](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Qianfan-OCR/discussions/7)).

Version questions for Transformers and vLLM and a failed cloud deployment ([HF #8, 23.03.2026](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Qianfan-OCR/discussions/8); [HF #15, 30.04.2026](https://huggingface.co/baidu/Qianfan-OCR/discussions/15)).
